caption: The drawing features a mechanical device composed primarily of wood and metal components, vertically oriented on a plain, light-colored background. The main structure consists of a tall, rectangular wooden board with a notch at the top and a broader base at the bottom. Attached centrally is a vertical rack gear made of metal, flanked by two metal brackets. A horizontal handle with a wooden grip is affixed to the left side of the rack and connects to a crank mechanism that operates the vertical metal gear. At the top, a green, dome-shaped metal cap covers the joint where the rack connects to the top notched section. The device is rendered with brown and tan shades for the wood, dark metallic gray for the gear and brackets, and green for the cap. At the bottom center of the image, there is a labeled scale indicating "3 inches," and the bottom right bears a handwritten signature. The overall composition is technical and detailed, focusing solely on the mechanical object centered on the page.
